content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sharing the agreement. I have a couple of minor points to review before signing. - In the relevant clause covering intellectual property, ownership currently transfers upon creation prior to receiving full payment; I propose that ownership transfer upon receipt of full payment for the applicable deliverables. - In the relevant clause covering milestone payments, the current terms make payment conditional on subjective satisfaction; I propose modifying this so that acceptance is not unreasonably withheld or delayed. Thank you for your time and understanding.
